triggers.pwa_history_compression_insert:
CREATE TRIGGER pwa_history_compression_insert AFTER INSERT ON sessions
            WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sessions WHERE id=new.parent_session_id AND end_reason='compression')
                AND ((CASE WHEN new.model_config IS NULL THEN '{}'
        WHEN length(new.model_config)<=16384 AND json_valid(new.model_config) THEN
            CASE WHEN json_type(new.model_config)='object' THEN new.model_config END END) IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN new.origin_json IS NULL THEN '{}'
        WHEN length(new.origin_json)<=16384 AND json_valid(new.origin_json) THEN
            CASE WHEN json_type(new.origin_json)='object' THEN new.origin_json END END) IS NULL OR
                    (new.source!='tool' AND json_extract((CASE WHEN new.model_config IS NULL THEN '{}'
        WHEN length(new.model_config)<=16384 AND json_valid(new.model_config) THEN
            CASE WHEN json_type(new.model_config)='object' THEN new.model_config END END),'$._delegate_from') IS NULL
                     AND json_extract((CASE WHEN new.model_config IS NULL THEN '{}'
        WHEN length(new.model_config)<=16384 AND json_valid(new.model_config) THEN
            CASE WHEN json_type(new.model_config)='object' THEN new.model_config END END),'$._branched_from') IS NOT new.parent_session_id))
            BEGIN UPDATE native_pwa_history_fence SET generation=generation+1 WHERE singleton=1; END
triggers.pwa_history_message_after_insert:
CREATE TRIGGER pwa_history_message_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON messages BEGIN
            UPDATE native_pwa_history_fence SET generation=generation+pending_message_replace,
                pending_message_replace=0 WHERE singleton=1; END
triggers.pwa_history_message_before_insert:
CREATE TRIGGER pwa_history_message_before_insert BEFORE INSERT ON messages BEGIN
            UPDATE native_pwa_history_fence SET pending_message_replace=EXISTS(
                SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE id=new.id AND (role!='session_meta' OR new.role!='session_meta'))
                WHERE singleton=1; END
triggers.pwa_history_message_delete:
CREATE TRIGGER pwa_history_message_delete AFTER DELETE ON messages
            WHEN old.role!='session_meta' BEGIN
            UPDATE native_pwa_history_fence SET generation=generation+1 WHERE singleton=1; END
triggers.pwa_history_message_update:
CREATE TRIGGER pwa_history_message_update
            AFTER UPDATE OF id,session_id,role,content,tool_call_id,tool_calls,tool_name,timestamp,active,compacted,display_kind,display_metadata ON messages
            WHEN (old.role!='session_meta' OR new.role!='session_meta') AND (old.id IS NOT new.id OR old.session_id IS NOT new.session_id OR old.role IS NOT new.role OR old.content IS NOT new.content OR old.tool_call_id IS NOT new.tool_call_id OR old.tool_calls IS NOT new.tool_calls OR old.tool_name IS NOT new.tool_name OR old.timestamp IS NOT new.timestamp OR old.active IS NOT new.active OR old.compacted IS NOT new.compacted OR old.display_kind IS NOT new.display_kind OR old.display_metadata IS NOT new.display_metadata) BEGIN
            UPDATE native_pwa_history_fence SET generation=generation+1 WHERE singleton=1; END
triggers.pwa_history_session_after_insert:
CREATE TRIGGER pwa_history_session_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON sessions BEGIN
            UPDATE native_pwa_history_fence SET generation=generation+pending_session_replace,
                pending_session_replace=0 WHERE singleton=1; END
triggers.pwa_history_session_before_insert:
CREATE TRIGGER pwa_history_session_before_insert BEFORE INSERT ON sessions BEGIN
            UPDATE native_pwa_history_fence SET pending_session_replace=EXISTS(
                SELECT 1 FROM sessions WHERE id=new.id OR (new.title IS NOT NULL AND title=new.title))
                WHERE singleton=1; END
triggers.pwa_history_session_delete:
CREATE TRIGGER pwa_history_session_delete AFTER DELETE ON sessions BEGIN
            UPDATE native_pwa_history_fence SET generation=generation+1 WHERE singleton=1; END
triggers.pwa_history_session_update:
CREATE TRIGGER pwa_history_session_update
            AFTER UPDATE OF id,source,user_id,chat_id,chat_type,thread_id,profile_name,parent_session_id,origin_json,title,started_at,end_reason,model_config ON sessions
            WHEN old.id IS NOT new.id OR old.source IS NOT new.source OR old.user_id IS NOT new.user_id OR old.chat_id IS NOT new.chat_id OR old.chat_type IS NOT new.chat_type OR old.thread_id IS NOT new.thread_id OR old.profile_name IS NOT new.profile_name OR old.parent_session_id IS NOT new.parent_session_id OR old.origin_json IS NOT new.origin_json OR old.title IS NOT new.title OR old.started_at IS NOT new.started_at OR COALESCE(old.end_reason='compression',0) IS NOT COALESCE(new.end_reason='compression',0) OR (CASE WHEN length(old.model_config)>16384 THEN json_object('_unavailable',1)
        WHEN old.model_config IS NULL THEN json_object('_branched_from',NULL,'_delegate_from',NULL)
        WHEN json_valid(old.model_config) THEN CASE WHEN json_type(old.model_config)='object'
            THEN json_object('_branched_from',json_extract(old.model_config,'$._branched_from'),
                             '_delegate_from',json_extract(old.model_config,'$._delegate_from'))
            ELSE old.model_config END ELSE old.model_config END) IS NOT (CASE WHEN length(new.model_config)>16384 THEN json_object('_unavailable',1)
        WHEN new.model_config IS NULL THEN json_object('_branched_from',NULL,'_delegate_from',NULL)
        WHEN json_valid(new.model_config) THEN CASE WHEN json_type(new.model_config)='object'
            THEN json_object('_branched_from',json_extract(new.model_config,'$._branched_from'),
                             '_delegate_from',json_extract(new.model_config,'$._delegate_from'))
            ELSE new.model_config END ELSE new.model_config END) BEGIN
            UPDATE native_pwa_history_fence SET generation=generation+1 WHERE singleton=1; END
